verdict.rationale: Daryanani Law Group is a boutique immigration law firm that handles sensitive client personal data. Asking whether clients can control retention and deletion of that data is a fair privacy-posture question for a service like this, so the axis applies. The evidence pack covers only visa service offerings, firm background, attorney supervision and a newsletter signup, with nothing on data retention, deletion requests or privacy controls.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
